shortDescription: Sundar Iyer, one of NSE’s largest individual shareholders, looks back at the Iyer family’s investment journey and the patience it took to reach listing day. From buying NSE shares at ₹800 to waiting nearly seven years, Iyer shares why he continues to focus on long-term growth and compounding.

title: NSE Listing: Shareholder Sundar Iyer on his 7-year wait and long-term growth bet
